status: Guide performance scenarios, not measured flight performance or flight approval

weight.label: CALCULATED ESTIMATE
weight.front_line: 2.66 kg estimated with flight battery; weigh the completed aircraft.

battery.label: OWNER-REPORTED/RATED
battery.note: 70–80% is an explicit planning assumption, not measured usable capacity or a battery-voltage limit; voltage sag or condition can reduce usable capacity further.

stall.label: CALCULATED SCENARIO
stall.assumptions: Level, unaccelerated flight; CLmax0.8–1.2 and density1.10–1.225kg/m3 are assumptions, not tested airfoil performance. Values are true airspeeds, not GPS groundspeed. Gusts, turns, build deviations and contamination are outside this range.
stall.front_line: Estimated stall 39-50 km/h under assumed lift/density; unmeasured.
stall.full_mass_sensitivity_note: Mass sensitivity 2.20-3.30 kg; not a guaranteed envelope.

speed_reference.label: ILLUSTRATIVE CALCULATION, NOT A PILOT COMMAND
speed_reference.note: 1.3Vs is retained as an explicit analysis margin from the existing scenario sheet, not asserted as a validated rotate/liftoff/approach speed or a manufacturer instruction. No1.2Vs liftoff rule has been adopted.

endurance.label: CONDITIONAL CAPACITY/CURRENT SCENARIOS
endurance.front_line: If average pack current is10/15/20A: about22–25/15–17/11–12.5minutes using70–80% of rated capacity. Actual cruise current is unknown.
endurance.note: Pack-average current includes motor, avionics, servos and the complete flight including launch/climb. This is arithmetic, not a prediction that the aircraft can cruise at those currents. The reserve is already excluded; do not add it again as extra flight time. Older drag-model rows are not measured cruise or guaranteed endurance.

runway.label: UNKNOWN; CONDITIONAL EXAMPLES ONLY
runway.formula: For zero wind, level ground and equivalent constant net acceleration: s=V_ground_target^2/(2*a_net). Instantaneously, a_net=(T-D-mu*max(0,m*g*cos(theta)-L)-m*g*sin(theta))/m. Variable acceleration requires integration or measured acceleration-vs-speed.
runway.front_line: Required runway length is not established. Ground roll, directional control and climb performance need measurements.
runway.example_copy: In still air, reaching an illustrative18m/s takes81–162m if mean net acceleration is2–1m/s2. Those accelerations are assumed. These distances exclude climb-to-clear-obstacle and rejected-takeoff stopping.
runway.planning_margin_note: An arbitrary2x multiplier would give162–324m for those two cases. It is a sensitivity illustration only, not a safe runway recommendation, certified margin or obstacle/abort calculation. No finite runway promise follows if available net thrust cannot reach the target speed.
unknown_inputs: Thrust vs airspeed/RPM and current on exact motor/prop/4S pack
Rolling resistance and wheel/leg deflection on actual surface
Actual wheel contact locations and prop clearance during pitch rotation
Aerodynamic drag/lift during ground run and demonstrated lift-off attitude
Surface slope, wind, density and obstacle/abort clearances
Available rudder/V-tail directional authority with fixed non-steering wheels

launch.label: CONDITIONAL PLAN
launch.method: Wheeled ground takeoff on a smooth, level, unobstructed runway after ground qualification and experienced RC pilot review.
launch.front_line: Planned launch: smooth-runway roll, conditional on propulsion, gear/prop clearance and straight tracking tests. No hand-launch, bungee or catapult method is qualified.
practical_sequence: Weigh/balance the finished model and complete structural/control checks first.

Resolve motor/prop suitability with manufacturer guidance and a properly secured instrumented bench setup; record loaded voltage, current, thrust, RPM and motor/ESC temperature. The40A ESC rating alone does not establish margin.

Fit wheel assemblies straight, lock any swivel, prove attachment/load response and prop clearance under the intended rotation attitude; an experienced pilot must approve directional control on fixed wheels.
Use controlled low-speed tracking tests first, with a predefined stop plan and clear area; do not chase the calculated18m/s example in an unqualified high-speed ground run.
After qualification, use supervised flight measurements to establish operating speeds and endurance. Do not use automatic takeoff as a substitute for airframe testing.
launch.excluded_methods: No bungee hook, catapult load path or restraint/release interface was designed. A2.55kg pusher with an exposed rear propeller has no approved hand-launch grip/procedure in this package.

propulsion.label: UNQUALIFIED / IMPORTANT PERFORMANCE GATE
propulsion.front_line: Motor/prop suitability remains unresolved: the motor is described for7-inch props; the owned9-inch three-blade is outside that application. Takeoff/climb capability and current/temperature margin are unmeasured.
propulsion.conclusion: Do not label this combination proven adequate or definitely inadequate from KV alone. Do not infer4S performance from6S or different-prop tests.

replace_estimates.weight: Use actual all-up scale mass and actual balance; rerun Vs proportional to sqrt(m).
replace_estimates.stall: After ground qualification, experienced-pilot test data at safe altitude plus calibrated airspeed and actual density can replace assumed CLmax. Not a maiden-flight low-speed target.
replace_estimates.endurance: Calibrate current sensor, log whole-flight consumed mAh and current, check pack condition and loaded voltage; use measured usable capacity with an explicit landing reserve.
replace_estimates.runway: Obtain exact propulsion data, low-speed rolling/tracking results and qualified flight takeoff/climb/abort observations on the actual surface; do not derive runway length from static thrust alone.

sources.supports: Lift equation; CL depends on actual shape and flow. Does not supply Reaper CLmax.
Net force/mass gives acceleration; constant-force kinematics. Does not supply Reaper thrust.
Official ECOII2807 page describes 7-inch-prop application; no exact owned9-inch/4S performance qualification.
9045-3 is9inch,4.5inch pitch,3blades,M5; compatible motor range listed2808–3118. Exact ownedprop variant still checked on its packaging.
Runway alignment/heading and wheeled steering configuration matter. Autopilot takeoff mode is not qualification of this fixed-wheel prototype.
Takeoff performance depends on runway condition/slope, weight, wind, elevation and temperature. No full-scale rule of thumb is adopted for this model.

balance.label: CALCULATED ESTIMATE; NOT VALIDATED FLIGHT CG
balance.note: 20% MAC is an analysis starting point, not a validated flight CG; measured balance and trim review required

integration_note: REV4: all wooden structure is 6 mm plywood with paired frame/wing lap joints; moving controls are flat 5 mm foamboard. Projected outline is retained closely, but changed camber and material/joint behaviour require physical qualification. Actual-section ideal-bond beam calculations do not establish joint strength, torsion or flight readiness.
